root_causes: Pressurization mode selector left on MAN instead of AUTO after overnight cabin leak test

Crew misidentified altitude alarm at 12,040 ft and suffered insidious hypobaric hypoxia above 18,000 ft
Flight attendant Andreas Prodromou (holding UK CPL) used portable oxygen bottle to reach cockpit before fuel exhaustion
